research_mode: official Ministry of Justice accredited statistics; fail-closed limitations; no parcel score, candidate value or business result

sources.name: Magistrates plea data quality
verified_claims: Published magistrates' plea counts were removed while identified data-quality concerns are resolved.
limitations: Removed or quality-constrained fields must not be inferred or substituted.

sources.name: Publication review
verified_claims: MoJ is reviewing tables to consolidate tools, remove duplication and rebalance annual and quarterly data.
limitations: Publication restructuring can affect comparability and does not support parcel scoring.

sources.name: Low-volume series review
verified_claims: MoJ is considering whether to continue commentary on penalty notices and cannabis or khat warnings because volumes are very low.
limitations: Low volumes reduce analytical value and cannot justify local extrapolation.

sources.name: Police-recorded crime total
verified_claims: Police recorded 6.38 million crimes in the latest year.
limitations: Police-recorded crime is influenced by activity and recording practices and is not parcel evidence.

sources.name: Police-recorded crime change
verified_claims: Police-recorded crime decreased by 4% from the previous year.
limitations: Recorded changes may reflect recording stabilisation rather than true prevalence.

sources.name: Police-recorded crime decade comparison
verified_claims: The 6.38 million total remained above 4.42 million recorded in 2015.
limitations: A national decade comparison cannot identify exact local risk.

sources.name: Recording-practice guard
verified_claims: The publication states that police-recorded crime levels are influenced by police activity and recording practices.
limitations: This caveat requires fail-closed treatment for parcel attribution.

sources.name: Charge volume
verified_claims: Charge volumes increased to 531,200 in the latest year.
limitations: Charge volume is a justice-system flow measure, not a parcel outcome.

sources.name: Charge volume change
verified_claims: Charge volumes increased by 15% and were the highest since 2015.
limitations: National charge growth cannot be assigned to a property.

sources.name: Indictable share
verified_claims: Indictable offences accounted for 18% of individuals dealt with.
limitations: The system-wide share is not a local offence probability.
